messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: control-plane.alerts -> Elevated 5xx rate (3x baseline) across auth + org-lookup + billing fanout in us-west-2. Threshold breached at 10:42 UTC. Affected route: /v1/generate (ingress-gateway). Alert links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/3427501111, runbook: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/controlplane-deps
Frank H (oncall): I'm on it. pulling traces from apm now. first thought: large fanout to org-lookup + billing seen in traces.
Ben K (eng-runtime): I see a spike in org-lookup latency -> 500/504 responses. Gateway is cascading 502/504 back to clients. Traces: majority of failures have long upstream connect time to org-lookup (50-200ms outliers) then billing calls timing out.
Carla P (eng-platform): Can we throttle fanout at the gateway to reduce concurrency to org-lookup? There's a config flag to limit parallel deps for control-plane route. Suggest setting max_parallel_deps=3 for now. Also prepare fallback route serving cached org data for TTL=30s.
Diego S (prod-support): Customer impact: several PLG seats reporting request failures; hitting support now. One customer (acme-corp) seeing 502s repeatedly.
Erin C (cust-succ): Confirmed — we've got two escalations in the queue. Best to prioritize minimizing errors vs throughput.
Frank H (oncall): Running quick synthetic to reproduce:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
Gateway returns 502 within 120ms. Logs show upstream org-lookup 504.
Ben K (eng-runtime): On the org-lookup side, metrics show thread-pool saturations and increased DB timeouts. Rolling restart would be high-risk. Can we enable degraded-mode cache path and reduce fanout first?
Carla P (eng-platform): Pushing config change to gateway to limit parallel dep calls and enable cached fallback. I'll stage a canary with 10% traffic in us-west-2.
deploy-bot: config-change queued: gateway.limit_parallel_deps=3, gateway.enable_orgcache_fallback=true, rollout: canary=10% -> target=100%
Frank H (oncall): Applying runbook step 3 (reduce fanout) now. Tracking metrics: error rate should drop within 1m if effective.
Ben K (eng-runtime): Noted billing service also reporting increased p50/p95. Might be downstream effect. We'll temporarily increase billing client timeout to 5s from 2s to reduce retries.
Carla P (eng-platform): Actioned: canary applied to 10% at 10:47 UTC. Watchgateway logs: reduced concurrent calls to org-lookup for canary traffic.
Frank H (oncall): Metrics: canary error rate down ~40% for that slice. Rolling to 50%.
deploy-bot: canary -> 50% at 10:48:30 UTC. change id: cfg-3427501111-01
Diego S (prod-support): Early reduction visible in customer telemetry for acme-corp: their errors dropped from 18% -> 6% on canary path.
Erin C (cust-succ): I'll message acme-corp interim note: "We're mitigating elevated errors, partial relief observed; will follow up" :thumbsup:
Ben K (eng-runtime): While rolling, I also toggled gateway retry policy: disable mutliple retries to avoid amplifying load. Added quick circuit-breaker for org-lookup after 5 failures/10s.
Frank H (oncall): Error rate across us-west-2 now trending down overall ~65% reduction compared to peak. Still seeing occasional 5xx from billing path. Next step: coordinate with billing on reducing DB fanout and long tail latencies.
Carla P (eng-platform): Can we set a soft degrade for non-critical billing calls (async) for 15m window? I'll open a short-lived feature-flag.
Ben K (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a targeted trace sample to send to billing eng with correlation ids.
deploy-bot: gateway rollout to 100% complete at 10:51:15 UTC. change id: cfg-3427501111-01
Frank H (oncall): Rolling mitigation complete. Monitoring for 20m. Current status: errors down to ~1.3x baseline, latency tails improving. No broad customer-impacting errors open now, but keep paging if regression.
Diego S (prod-support): Maintaining support watch. I've closed the high-severity note for acme-corp and escalated to billing eng for root cause.
Erin C (cust-succ): Sent update to customers affected. Will reopen if they see recurrence.
Ben K (eng-runtime): Action items: (1) org-lookup: increase DB connection pool and apply query-optimizations (owner: org-lookup eng) (2) billing: investigate long tail latency/locks (owner: billing eng) (3) gateway: keep fanout limit as safety default for 1h then relax (owner: eng-platform)
Frank H (oncall): Handoff: I'm paged out in 18m; if error rate stays <=1.5x baseline I'll hand to oncall-backfill. Next oncall: Ben K (oncall-backfill) will pick up post-mitigation checks.
Ben K (eng-runtime): I'll take the post-mortem and coordinate with billing/org-lookup teams. Leaving a quick log snippet for postmortem:
```
peak window: 10:42-10:50 UTC
symptom: gateway 5xx due to upstream org-lookup timeouts + billing tail latencies
mitigation: gateway fanout limit, org-cache fallback, disable retries, circuit-breaker
impact: transient 502/504 across us-west-2, partial customer impact (acme-corp)
```
Frank H (oncall): Thanks team. I'll update the incident channel after 20m stable window. If visible regression, re-open paging. :white_check_mark:
